`interface IVulkanHost`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`WindowVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/windowvulkanhost/), [`SnapshotVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/snapshotvulkanhost/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.host` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [IVulkanHost.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/host/IVulkanHost.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

What an application or an engine that renders with Vulkan lends JOID: the device, the queue, the command buffer of the frame and the target image.

## Description

JOID records into the frame of the host instead of owning one; [`WindowVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/windowvulkanhost/) and [`SnapshotVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/snapshotvulkanhost/) are complete hosts.

## Learn more

- [Run inside a Vulkan host](/build/backends/vulkan/#run-inside-a-vulkan-host)
